using namespace std;

const long MOD = 998244353L;
const int INF = 1000000007;

long power(long x, long y, long m) {
    if (y < 0) return 0L;
    long ans = 1;
    x %= m;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y % 2 == 1)
            ans = (ans * x) % m;
        y /= 2;
        x = (x * x) % m;
    }
    return ans;
}

long choose(int n, int k) {
    long den = (n * power(n - k, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD;
    long ans = (power(k, MOD - 2, MOD) * power(den, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD;
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    mt19937 rng(chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count());
